title: VIEW code-334 LiveSection fail-closed export and no-UCS compatibility fast slice
mode: local generated DXF implementation and focused validation
scope: Retain fail-closed behavior for nonzero VIEW code-334 when its target/owner graph is not represented in DXF export
Verify parser retention, transactional refusal, same-adapter corrected retry, and direct-writer refusal for ASCII and Binary DXF
Resolve no-UCS orthographic-field validation against the conditional VIEW group-72/79 DXF contract
Keep the slice DXF-only and avoid persistent test drawings, new registrations, broad suites, and support promotion

implementation.behavior: Adapter preflight and direct VIEW writer continue to reject a nonzero LiveSection handle. Their UCS checks now treat group 79 as conditional on hasUCS/group 72, avoiding rejection of the model's legacy ucsOrthoType=1 default when no UCS is associated; nonzero named/base UCS references without hasUCS remain rejected.
testControls: Generated ASCII and Binary AC1027 VIEW with explicit code72=0 and code334=0x777 parses and retains the LiveSection handle.
Adapter export of the nonzero LiveSection edge fails while preserving a pre-existing destination.
Clearing only the unsupported LiveSection handle allows the same adapter/data to export and re-import successfully.
Raw output scan verifies group72=0, no code334, and no inapplicable code79.
Direct low-level writer refuses a nonzero LiveSection edge atomically in ASCII and Binary DXF.

focusedResults: VIEW code-334 LiveSection fail-closed export: PASS
UCS orthographic DXF option tuples: PASS; the selector printed expected reader diagnostics for negative malformed controls

evidence.observed: Group 72 indicates whether a UCS is associated. The UCS group-code subsection states that groups 110/120/130, 111/121/131, 112/122/132, 79, 146, 345, and 346 appear only when group 72 is 1. Group 334 is an optional soft pointer to a LiveSection object.

DRW_View::reset initializes hasUCS=false and ucsOrthoType=1. The generated DXF controls exercise the valid no-UCS case and the unsupported nonzero LiveSection case without modifying DWG serialization.

assessment.confirmedPlanGapClosed: Nonzero VIEW code-334 DXF export now remains fail-closed at adapter and direct-writer boundaries with atomic refusal coverage and corrected retry coverage.
assessment.limitations: The slice does not retain or serialize LiveSection objects/owners and does not qualify target class, native VIEW behavior, or 3D semantics. The full fixture CTest and full suite were not run; earlier broad fixture runner failures remain unattributed. The shared working tree remains broadly modified and uncommitted.
